It lists various food items (likely Chinese cuisine given the 'Dim Sum' header) with prices in HKD. The top of the menu shows branding logos. The fingers holding the menu are indistinct and blend into the paper edge. The anatomy of the thumb/fingers is vague and lacks clear definition, suggesting generation failure in complex occlusion areas.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' severity. In AI images, text often looks real from a distance but fails OCR. If the image_text_auditor finds high rates of non-word strings, increase artifact severity. Also, scrutinize the hand; AI often struggles with fingers interacting with flat surfaces. If the hand looks melted or has wrong finger count, this is a significant structural defect.
